label: Shared spatial layout design
definition: Coordinating where shared digital content and workspace elements are placed.
inclusion_rule: Include when collaborators jointly arrange or adapt spatial workspaces.

label: Viewpoint and perspective alignment
definition: Sharing or aligning what collaborators can see from different positions or displays.
inclusion_rule: Include when 2D/3D views, perspectives or sight lines are coordinated.

label: Spatial annotations and guidance cues
definition: Using spatially anchored marks, gestures, or instructions to direct another person.
inclusion_rule: Include when instructions or annotations are associated with places or objects.

label: Physical-scene capture and sharing
definition: Capturing and communicating a real environment to a remote immersive participant.
inclusion_rule: Include when sharing physical surroundings is a primary technical aim.

label: Collaborative digital-twin editing
definition: Jointly editing or synchronizing digital replicas of physical sites or systems.
inclusion_rule: Include when a digital twin is a shared object of collaborative editing.

label: Shared object manipulation
definition: Two or more people coordinate to move, modify, or control the same object.
inclusion_rule: Include when shared object actions are a research focus.

label: Tangible and hand-based input
definition: Using physical objects or hand tracking as inputs during collaborative interaction.
inclusion_rule: Include when hand/object interfaces mediate collaboration.

label: Co-gestures and shared agency
definition: Coordinated gestures, joint agency, or intention in joint action.
inclusion_rule: Include when participants intentionally couple their gestures or agency.

label: Kinesthetic guidance and co-manipulation
definition: Using movement or force-based feedback for physically coupled cooperation or instruction.
inclusion_rule: Include when the work investigates guided motion or force feedback.

label: Haptic social communication
definition: Communicating social signals or interpersonal contact through touch or vibration.
inclusion_rule: Include when haptics conveys social meaning, not merely tactile input.

label: Asymmetric sensory feedback
definition: Supporting collaborators who receive or generate different forms of sensory feedback.
inclusion_rule: Include when asymmetry of sensory channels is explicitly investigated.

label: Avatar embodiment and representation
definition: Representing a collaborator through an avatar, including control, ownership, or body cues.
inclusion_rule: Include when avatar characteristics, embodiment or control matter to the study.

label: Social presence and co-presence
definition: Investigating how people perceive and experience being together in mediated spaces.
inclusion_rule: Include when social/co-presence is an explicit target or outcome.

label: Nonverbal social intent cues
definition: Communicating intentions or states through gaze, gesture, body position, or facial signals.
inclusion_rule: Include when such nonverbal cues are a design/evaluation focus.

label: Socio-emotional awareness
definition: Sharing, expressing, or regulating emotion and interpersonal states in a group.
inclusion_rule: Include when emotion or socio-emotional group states are explicit.

label: Awareness of collaborators’ work
definition: Understanding others’ current activities, shared context or task states.
inclusion_rule: Include when mutual task/workspace awareness is explicit.

label: Group coordination and joint action
definition: Coordinating participants’ contributions and actions toward a shared goal.
inclusion_rule: Include when coordination itself is studied beyond simply having multiple users.

label: Group cohesion and membership transitions
definition: Keeping a group together or handling changing group participation during transitions.
inclusion_rule: Include when collaboration continuity, joining/leaving or group formation is central.

label: Mobile and on-the-go collaboration
definition: Collaborating while one or more participants physically move or change locations.
inclusion_rule: Include when mobility or movement constraints are a research focus.

label: Remote expert assistance
definition: Guidance between a remote expert/mentor and an on-site operator or learner.
inclusion_rule: Include when expert–novice or expert–operator assistance is explicit.

label: Collaborative skill learning
definition: Learning or training skills together using shared tasks, instruction, or guidance.
inclusion_rule: Include when skill acquisition or educational collaboration is a goal.

label: Accessible and personalized participation
definition: Adapting collaborative participation for different abilities or specific support needs.
inclusion_rule: Include when accessibility or accommodation is an explicit goal.

label: Social acceptability in public spaces
definition: Supporting collaboration while respecting the social norms and constraints of public settings.
inclusion_rule: Include when public-space social acceptance or gestural restraint is studied.

label: Collaborative art and performance
definition: Co-producing artistic work or performances through immersive interaction.
inclusion_rule: Include when collaboration produces or shapes artistic expression.

label: Participatory co-creation and design
definition: Multiple stakeholders co-design an artifact, exhibition, or experience.
inclusion_rule: Include when participants jointly shape a designed outcome.

label: Complex engineering problem-solving
definition: Collaborative exploration, review or design of technically complex systems.
inclusion_rule: Include when joint technical problem-solving is the primary task.

label: Collaborative therapy and telehealth
definition: Mediated joint activities in clinical support, rehabilitation or mental-health contexts.
inclusion_rule: Include when a therapeutic or clinical group activity is central.

label: Measuring collaborative experience
definition: Operationalizing collaboration quality, interaction outcomes or group experience.
inclusion_rule: Include only when measuring collaboration/experience is explicitly part of the study.

label: Adaptive XR interfaces and layouts
definition: Adapting presentation, control or interface arrangements to user or context.
inclusion_rule: Include when adaptation/personalization of the interface is researched.

label: Activity and intent recognition
definition: Inferring actions, intentions or coordination states from sensed participant behavior.
inclusion_rule: Include when sensing-based recognition is a research objective.

label: AI-mediated visual modifications
definition: Using generative AI to modify rendered physical environments or social cues.
inclusion_rule: Include when AI-driven generation/modification of visuals is explicit.

label: Neural and physiological coordination signals
definition: Using brain/physiological measurements to study collaborative synchrony or alignment.
inclusion_rule: Include when EEG/BCI or inter-brain measurements are an explicit method.

label: Cross-device participation
definition: Collaborators use materially different immersive, physical or screen-based devices.
inclusion_rule: Include when device asymmetry is a substantive design variable.

label: Physical collaboration at a distance
definition: Enabling shared physical action, force or contact despite remote separation.
inclusion_rule: Include when physical coupling across distance is a goal.

label: Conversational communication and flow
definition: Supporting timing, attention and communication continuity in live group talk.
inclusion_rule: Include when conversation dynamics or speech-supported social interaction is studied.

label: Real-time synchronization and resilience
definition: Keeping remote information, objects or interactions synchronized despite disruptions.
inclusion_rule: Include when synchronization, latency or disrupted connectivity is explicit.
